h: Tonto Dikeh shares video of herself conducting deliverance at church
p: Actress Tonto Dikeh has reportedly shared a video of herself praying for people and conducting deliverance during a church service. The clip has drawn mixed reactions online.
body: Nollywood actress Tonto Dikeh has drawn attention online after sharing a video of herself conducting deliverance during a church service.
The actress, who owns a church in Abuja, was seen praying and ministering to people at the gathering, fully immersed in the spiritual exercise.

Tonto has increasingly made her Christian faith and ministry a central part of her public life, and has spoken about her passion for prayer and helping others. She also recently celebrated a gift to her church from cleric Jerry Eze, describing it as a testimony beyond words.
The clip drew a range of reactions online, with some praising her devotion and others questioning it.
more: Tonto owns a church in Abuja.
She was seen praying and ministering to people.
